acceptanceCriteria: The build log names gate-a and the GateRun read path, citing the test at a pinned commit.
body: Found in lane L (PR beamfall/corvint#748). docs/build-log/2026-10-10-stage-slot-race.md says the V1-0467 racer was `submit-a`; at 30e306ec racer 2 of TestCALV0019_RacingLeaseVerbsLeaveOneConsistentHead is `gate-a`, whose GateRun makes the unlocked lease read (unlockedAttemptProof -> readLeaseProof -> AuditForWrite) before taking the lock.
title: Correct the V1-0467 racer name in the stage-slot race build log (gate-a, not submit-a)
